title: Eventual successive quotient comparisons
statement: theorem coherentFormalModule_kernel_quotient_comparison_bound {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F H : CoherentFormalModule X I) (α : F ⟶ H) (c : ℕ) (S : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ X.Modules) (j : S ⟶ F.obj) (hc : ∀ (l m : ℕ) (h : m + c ≤ l), Subobject.mk (Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op l)) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right m c) h)).op)) = Subobject.mk (Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op))) (hS : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ e : S.obj (op m) ≅ Abelian.image (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op), e.hom ≫ Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op) = j.app (op m)) : ∃ b : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, max c b ≤ d → ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ e : formalModuleQuotient I (n + 1) ((formalShiftedQuotient I S d).obj (op (n + 1))) ≅ (formalShiftedQuotient I S d).obj (op n), formalModuleQuotientπ I (n + 1) ((formalShiftedQuotient I S d).obj (op (n + 1))) ≫ e.hom = (formalShiftedQuotient I S d).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op

proof.text: For every d and n use the proved transition epimorphism assertion. Choose b from the eventual exactness bound, and for d >= max(c,b) use its zero composite and exactness at level n+1. ShortComplex.Exact.gIsCokernel makes the transition target a cokernel of the ideal-product inclusion. Compare it with the chosen formalModuleQuotient via cokernelIsCokernel and coconePointUniqueUpToIso. The comparison equation is comp_coconePointUniqueUpToIso_hom at WalkingParallelPair.one.
